products.title: Breville Bambino, 54 mm espresso
products.reason_to_buy: The one we would put in a small kitchen: heats in seconds and takes 54 mm accessories you can actually find.
products.detail:
We chose it for small kitchens: it heats up in seconds and takes 54 mm accessories you can actually find.
+ Compact footprint for a tight counter
+ Fast heat-up for weekday mornings
+ 54 mm portafilter: tampers and baskets are easy to find
Skip it if you want a built-in grinder. Measure your cabinet clearance first; the tank fills from the top.
products.image_alt: A Breville Bambino espresso machine in brushed stainless steel on a walnut counter, a latte with heart latte art, a jar of coffee beans and a pothos beside it.

products.title: Baratza Encore ESP burr grinder
products.reason_to_buy: Fine enough for espresso, quiet enough for a 6 a.m. house, and it fits under a cabinet.
products.detail:
We chose it because it grinds fine enough for espresso, stays quiet enough for an early house, and fits under a cabinet.
+ Stepped burrs with a true espresso range
+ Pairs with any 51 to 58 mm machine
+ Compact enough for under-cabinet counters
Skip it if you only make drip coffee; a simpler grinder will do.
products.image_alt: A black Baratza Encore ESP coffee grinder with a clear bean hopper on a speckled quartz counter, its dosing cup full of grounds, with a portafilter, tamper and espresso cup beside it.

products.title: CASABREWS espresso machine, 51 mm
products.reason_to_buy: The budget pick, with one catch: it takes 51 mm baskets, and most accessory kits do not.
products.detail:
We chose it as the budget way to start making espresso at home, with one catch worth knowing: it takes 51 mm baskets.
+ Simple, small and easy to start with
+ Steam wand for milk drinks
+ 51 mm portafilter
Skip it if you already own 54 or 58 mm tools; buy 51 mm accessories only.
products.image_alt: A stainless CASABREWS CM5418 espresso machine with a pressure gauge on a marble counter, a glass cup of espresso on the drip tray and biscotti beside it.

products.title: Keurig K-Classic, 3 cup sizes
products.reason_to_buy: The simple one: drop in a pod, press one of three buttons, and you have coffee in about a minute with nothing to measure or grind.
products.detail:
We chose it for the simplest possible morning: one pod, one button, a hot cup in about a minute, nothing to measure.
+ Three cup sizes: 6, 8 or 10 oz (6 oz is the strongest)
+ 48 oz tank lifts off the side to refill at the sink
+ Turns itself off after two hours idle
Skip it if you want espresso, milk drinks or a full pot. It stands about 13 in tall, so measure under your cabinets.
products.image_alt: A black Keurig K-Classic pod coffee maker, KEURIG on its silver band, brewing into a red mug on a walnut kitchen counter.

products.title: BISSELL Little Green Mini, spot cleaner
products.reason_to_buy: The small fix for messy moments: spray, scrub and suck up spills and pet accidents on couches, rugs and car seats.
products.detail:
We chose it because it handles the messes that actually happen: coffee on the couch, a pet accident on the rug, crumbs in car seats.
+ Sprays, scrubs and suctions in one pass
+ Stain tool and self-rinsing hose tool included
+ Small enough to keep in a closet
Skip it if you need to clean whole rooms of carpet. Empty and rinse the dirty-water tank after each use.
products.image_alt: A pale green BISSELL Little Green Mini spot cleaner with its coiled hose on an oak floor beside a cream sofa.

products.title: Ninja Professional Blender, 72 oz
products.reason_to_buy: Enough power to crush ice for frozen drinks, and a pitcher big enough to make smoothies for the whole family at once.
products.detail:
We chose it for families who blend big: enough power for ice and frozen fruit, and a pitcher that makes smoothies for everyone at once.
+ 1000-watt motor with stacked blades
+ 72 oz pitcher, 64 oz of liquid
+ Low, medium, high and pulse buttons
Skip it if you want a quiet blender, a single-serve cup or hot soups. It is about 16 in tall, and the blades are sharp when you wash the pitcher.
products.image_alt: A Ninja Professional blender full of berry smoothie, NINJA and its button labels on the charcoal base, on a walnut counter with strawberries.

products.title: La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 serum
products.reason_to_buy: A simple hydrating step: hyaluronic acid plus vitamin B5, a few drops before your moisturizer.
products.detail:
We chose it as one simple hydrating step you can add without rebuilding your routine: a few drops before moisturizer.
+ Hyaluronic acid plus vitamin B5
+ Dropper bottle, a few drops at a time
+ The brand says it suits sensitive skin
Skip it if you want to treat a skin condition; that is a question for a dermatologist. Patch-test first if your skin reacts easily.
products.image_alt: A La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 serum dropper bottle on a marble bathroom shelf beside a glass of water, a waffle towel and peony petals.

products.title: eufy E25 robot vacuum and mop
products.reason_to_buy: Vacuums and mops in one run, then empties, washes its mop and refills itself at the dock.
products.detail:
We chose it for hands-off floors: it vacuums and mops in one run, then empties, washes and dries itself at the dock.
+ Roller mop rinsed with clean water as it works
+ Dock empties dust, dries the mop and refills water
+ Side arm reaches along baseboards and corners
Skip it if you have no wall space for a tall dock. Dust bags and mop parts get replaced over time.
products.image_alt: A eufy E25 robot vacuum docked in its tall charcoal station in a warm living room with oak floors.
